translated_title: Construction of Mexibús Line 5 Reaches 16% Progress in the Valley of Mexico
original_title: Construcción de la Línea 5 del Mexibús alcanza 16% de avance en el Valle de México
author: Silvia Chávez González
meta_description: Construction of Mexibús Line 5 (Lechería–El Rosario) has reached 16% progress. The 30-kilometer line will serve over 137,000 residents across the western Valley of Mexico, with connections to the Suburban Train, Mexibús Line 2, and the El Rosario transfer hub.
